direction: 肝细胞癌免疫治疗耐药机制
key_points: | [1] | S1P 与耐药 | 代谢机制和干预 | NEK2/S1P 干预增强阻断疗效 | 跨体系外推未确认 |
| [2] | IL-8/CXCR2 与应答 | 动态活检、单细胞测序 | 循环 IL-8 关联较差应答 | 不等于普遍预测 |
| [3] | 乳酸化与 PD-L1 | 测序和分子实验 | MVP 上调稳定 PD-L1 | 联合机制待验证 |
| [4] | 微环境综合 | 细胞群与临床试验综述 | 细胞通讯参与逃逸和耐药 | 不替代机制实验 |
| 理论基础 | 免疫抑制微环境 [1][4] | 关注免疫逃逸 |
| 研究对象 | 巨噬细胞、髓源抑制细胞等 [1][2][3] | 细胞层级不同 |
| 研究问题 | 代谢、迁移、蛋白稳定性 [1][2][3] | 问题互补 |
| 技术方法 | 代谢干预、单细胞测序、分子实验 [1][2][3] | 不可混写 |

references.text: [1] ZHANG X, LAO M, SUN K, et al. Sphingolipid synthesis in tumor-associated macrophages confers immunotherapy resistance in hepatocellular carcinoma[J]. Science Advances, 2025. DOI:10.1126/sciadv.adv0558.

[2] Tsz Tung Kwong, XIONG Z, ZHANG Y, et al. Overcoming immunotherapy resistance in hepatocellular carcinoma by targeting myeloid IL-8/CXCR2 signaling[J]. Molecular Therapy, 2025. DOI:10.1016/j.ymthe.2025.02.002.

[3] LIU S, PAN Y, LIU W, et al. Lactylation-driven MVP upregulation boosts immunotherapy resistance by inhibiting PD-L1 degradation in hepatocellular carcinoma[J]. Journal for ImmunoTherapy of Cancer, 2025. DOI:10.1136/jitc-2025-012230.

[4] FU Y, GUO X, SUN L, et al. Exploring the role of the immune microenvironment in hepatocellular carcinoma: Implications for immunotherapy and drug resistance[J]. eLife, 2024. DOI:10.7554/elife.95009.
